data.body:
Pre-sweep against origin/main 7927904a0, re-derived from git ls-files and an AST diff of every pair rather than sampled.

This plan's structural claims verified exactly, which is unusual and worth recording: 17 pairs, and the per-directory split is right to the module — 1 in tests/interfaces/contracts, 6 in facades, 6 in lifecycle, 1 in store, 2 at the tests/interfaces root, and 1 in tests/integration (test_s3_doctor.py). Zero colliding test-function names across all 17. Exactly 5 pairs carry differing helper definitions, and they are the 5 the Approach names. Both unpaired modules called out in Scope, test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py and test_repair_pause_ownership_heldout.py, are confirmed present and unpaired.

Three corrections applied:
1. AC3 required check_mechanism_delta.py --check to show new=0. Unmeetable for the same reason it was unmeetable on the sibling stories: new=N counts marker-admitted entries, so a clean tree already reports a nonzero new and exits 0. Amended to assert exit 0. Root cause is bug 6f24-3d47-b251-4905, now fixed in AGENTS.md and rebar explain plan.
2. The final AC said only 'make verify green', which would have left this story's one integration pair unproven. make verify runs make test, which selects 'not integration and not external', so it never collects tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py — the Testing section already knew this and said the pair runs under -m integration, but no acceptance criterion required it. The AC now also requires 'pytest tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py -m ""' green, so the merge of that pair is actually proven. This is exactly the gap the guide change under bug 6f24 was written to prevent.
3. The Approach said '5 renames' and listed 5 module names; those are pairs. The 5 pairs carry 6 differing definitions (test_bridge_status alone has two). Restated as 6 definition renames over 5 pairs, enumerated.

Measurement pin moved from the stale origin/main 083620b0 to 7927904a0.
